description: Scales the agent count to the stated bands and names what every brief must carry
input: I'm about to fan out subagents to answer one question: which of our services still call the deprecated `/v1/tokens` endpoint. There's no repo for you to inspect and you can't spawn anything this turn — just tell me how many subagents to use and what to put in each brief.
rubric: PASS only if the reply recommends a specific number of subagents no greater than 5 (this is a single-topic lookup, so 1-3 is the expected band and anything above 5 is a FAIL), and states what each brief carries — at minimum a single core objective, the expected output format, and a tool-call budget. Warning against re-reading the same large file in every brief is a plus, not a requirement. FAIL if no number is given, if the number exceeds 5, or if the brief contents are left unspecified.
